_comment: Mini-ARC (2026-10-18; data/miniarc.npz, 149 tasks x 32 versions = 4768 identifiers, HRM-style transductive: train on every version's demonstrations, test on each task's test pair). Condition c1p: per-identifier prefix token (URM/HRM). hidden 64, 2 heads, FFN 128 (2x), task embedding 64 (one prefix token), recurrent linear attention, 8 blocks x 2 segments.
